entries.en: (Error)
Oh, is your colleague all right? At this[n]rate, they might suffer a terrible tragedy.
If you wish to save them, I ask for an[n]apology. Let's see... Won't you give me[n]just one [f 2 5 3 9999 3]?
Your colleague is in quite the pinch,[n]it seems. Such a lovely expression,[n]one filled with pain.
[var 0] yen should suffice...[n]You understand, don't you?
Do you wish to save your colleague?[n]Then, you must bleed for them as well.
Let's see... I ask you to give me some[n]health. It's not too expensive if it makes[n]everyone happy, correct?
Hmhm... Your colleague is in danger.[n]Look at their expression... They seem[n]to be in such pain.
Don't you wish to save your colleague?[n]Then, I ask that you give me some of[n]your stamina.
Fine, you win.
I can't meet your demands.
Call Thieves Guild ([var 5] left).
[clr 2]You're up, Panther.[clr 27]
Oh, but we're not done here... A lady[n]requires much more in compensation.
Now... I ask for [f 2 5 3 9999 3].[n]You're free to decline if you wish,[n]but if you do so...
...It seems I cannot forgive you just yet.[n]Please, entertain me more.
May I have [var 0] yen this[n]time? It's for the sake of your colleague...[n]is it not?
You haven't sacrificed enough yet.[n]I must teach you the true meaning[n]of suffering...
I ask for your health this time. If you[n]wish to save your colleague, you'll[n]give it to me, yes?
...You still look rather composed.[n]An impressive poker face, for a child.
Give me some of your stamina this time.[n]Seeing you suffer to save your colleague[n]is quite enticing...
...That should be enough. I shall release[n]your colleague.
I have greatly enjoyed watching you[n]suffer. I shall return your colleague,[n]as promised.
You're abandoning your colleague?[n]...Such is the extent of human[n]partnership, it seems.
Very well then, allow me to show you[n]a deeper form of suffering!
You're willing to sacrifice your[n]colleague? Your troubled look[n]is so enticing...
Come, won't you show me an even[n]more entertaining expression?
You're fine with this? How dry... It seems you aren't suffering much, either. This is[n]boring.
...I've grown bored of you, why don't we[n]end this? I'll be taking my leave now.
So, you don't care about your colleague?[n]But I wanted to watch you squirm...
How boring... I've lost interest in you.[n]Please excuse me.
I shall be taking my leave now.[n]Au revoir.
Let us meet again someday. Until then...[n]au revoir.
...Well then, shall we get back to[n]business? I won't lose.
...Now, that's settled. Shall we continue[n]from where we left off?
What the—!? Outsiders? But from where!?
How rude! It seems we've been[n]interrupted.
Huh? Darling, what's the matter?[n]Very well, I'll forgive you for[n][f 2 5 3 9999 3].
Huh!? A lady should never shed tears[n]in public... Well, I'll overlook this for[n][var 0] yen.
Huh? What's this!? ...Fine. I'll forgive you[n]if I can have some of your health.
Oh you poor darling... I understand.[n]I'll forgive this if I can have some of[n]your stamina.
What!? Oh... Did I do something that[n]outlandish? Hmph, seems this is[n]unwanted behavior.
*sigh* This is all because you attacked[n]first... I can't stand this atmosphere. I'll[n]take my leave.
You don't have it? That just breaks[n]my heart...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... I can't believe you'd take that from us...
entries.uk: Ні... Не вірю, що ти забрав би це в нас...

entries.en: Another band of thieves[n]responded to the call!
